title: Stay on 30A Property Management: Beachside Bliss in Dune Allen – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Beachside Bliss in Dune Allen. Welcome to 'Beachside Bliss' a luxurious coastal escape just steps from the sugar-white sands and directly across from Ft. Panic beach access.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Beachside Bliss,'  a luxurious coastal escape just steps from the sugar-white sands and directly across from Ft. Panic beach access. With sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and serene Allen Lake, this 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath estate comfortably hosts up to 16 guests, making it the ultimate setting for family gatherings, reunions, or upscale group getaways. Inside, enjoy a sunlit open-concept layout with refined coastal decor, a designer chef’s kitchen with premium finishes, and an expansive dining space perfect for group meals. Luxurious bedrooms offer ensuite baths, smart TVs, and private balconies, while custom bunk rooms create a stylish retreat for younger guests. Outside, your private resort awaits, featuring a resort-style pool, tranquil lakefront dock, gourmet outdoor kitchen, and ample space to unwind. Lounge in the sun, grill fresh seafood, kayak at sunset, or simply savor the breeze with a cocktail in hand. This ocean view property provides incredible amenities and spectacular views, as well as being a prime location for exploring local shops and restaurants. With 8 adult bikes, plus a 6-passenger golf cart, getting around has never been easier. Experience the ultimate relaxation and convenience at Beachside Bliss!  HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps from the beach -Gulf/Lake view  -Private pool with sitting spa **Pool heating available for $50 per day** -Complimentary beach setups each morning include 8 beach chairs with 4 umbrella (Mar 1 2025-Feb 28 2026) -6 Passenger golf cart -8 adult bikes -Elevator -Outdoor kitchen with built in gas grill -Washer and dryer on multiple floors -Drip/Keurig coffee maker -Fully equipped gourmet kitchen -Private lake dock with seating -Beach gear  -Soaking tub -Outdoor shower -4 dedicated parking spaces -4 Private balconies ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 16   FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom #1: King Bedroom, Shared Bathroom.  -Bedroom #2: Twin/Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom.  SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom #3: King Bedroom, With Private Ensuite.  THIRD FLOOR: -Bedroom #4: Twin/Twin & Twin/Full Bunk Beds, With Private Ensuite.  -Bedroom #5: King Bed, WIth Private Ensuite.  -Bedroom #6: King Bed,With Private Ensuite.  BEACH ACCESS The beach access is just a short walk from the home: 1. Fort Panic Regional Access: Just step out the front of the home, just a short walk across 30A. This access is ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located on Scenic 30A. Just across Scenic 30A lie Lake Allen and Oyster Lake, two of SoWal's rare coastal dune lakes. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING: Four driveway parking spaces available.  Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 8 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Pool & spa are heated together. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *Home must remain pet free.  IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app.   read more + less -
